Gleuhr Guide — Branch Manager (draft)
 Oct 27, 2026  ·  @Aman
This is the draft of the Branch Manager's module of the Gleuhr Guide, for your approval
before it is built into the app. It covers the BM's branch pages: approvals, exit meetings,
the team, targets, the bank slip and the day lock. The BM's own counsellor desk is covered
by the Counsellor guide.
What is in it: 40 How do I…? cards, 12 rules, 10 lessons with 30 check questions, 5 sign-
off tasks, and how the BM will sign off the team.
How it was checked: every button name and step was read from the app as it is today
(27 Oct). Every refusal message is quoted from the server. Nothing comes from
memory or the old manual.
Screenshots: made-up data only. Five are placed. The others are shown as [Screenshot
to add …] lines until they are rendered.
Who signs off a BM: the Sales Head, not another BM.
How to review: comment on any line, or edit it directly. Anything you change becomes
the text staff see.
1 · Responsibilities
What this desk is for. You run the branch. You decide what the people in your clinic
cannot decide for themselves, you meet the new patients who leave without buying, you
set your team's targets, and you lock the clinic's money day at night. You also have a
counsellor's desk of your own, below the "MY COUNSELLOR DESK" line in your menu.
The right person decides. Clinical decisions belong to the doctor. Price belongs to the
counsellor. Cash belongs to reception. Oversight belongs to you. You check other
people's work; you do not do it for them.
The Branch Manager
You own Approvals routed to your clinic · exit meetings with
new patients who did not buy · your team's daily
attendance (Team today) · checking calls saved as
done with no phone record · your counsellors'
targets (draft and submit) · handing over a leaving
counsellor's desk · the bank deposit slip for each
cash day · the End of Day lock

blocks.title: Page 2
blocks.text:
Your day, opening to lock.
1 . Morning. Open Approvals. Clear "Waiting on me". If the "BANK DEPOSIT" strip says a
day took cash with no slip, upload the slip. Open Team today and mark anyone who has
not come in.
2. Through the day. Meet the new patients who leave without a treatment (Exit
meetings). Keep an eye on Clinic Overview for patients waiting too long. Work your
own counsellor book.
3. Afternoon. Check Follow-up calls → No call record. Look at Sale & revenue to see
where the day stands.
4. Close. Open End of Day. Clear every check, count the cash drawer, and Lock the day.
You can only lock your own clinic's day.
2 · Rules
These are the rules that bind your desk. The app enforces most of them. Know them
anyway, so a refusal never surprises you.
The Branch Manager
You never decide Your own items (they go to the Sales Head) · a cash
correction or a store-credit exchange (the Sales
Head decides; you track) · a hard close of a patient
(only the counsellor) · anything clinical (the doctor)
· locking targets (the Sales Head) · a price on a
patient's plan (the counsellor)
Hands off to you Counsellors (exit meetings, items for approval,
target rows) · reception (waived fees, staged
payments, phone changes, exchanges) · the doctor
(session-count corrections) · the booking agent
(amount-check flags)
You hand off to The Sales Head (your own items, disagreements,
flags you raise at End of Day, your targets for
locking) · the owning counsellor (the follow-up you
set after an exit meeting) · the appointment agent
(rejected advances to re-capture)
The rule Why
No one approves their own item. Anything
you raise goes to the Sales Head.
The person who asks is never the person
who checks.
Gleuhr Guide — Branch Manager (draft)

3 · Processes
My pages
Your menu has two parts. Branch (open the first time you sign in) holds your manager
pages. MY COUNSELLOR DESK holds your counsellor pages, in four folded groups: Today
· Patients · Revenue · Safety nets. Click a group heading to open or fold it; the menu
The rule Why
You approve or send back; you never
change the number.
The person who owns a figure corrects it, so
the record shows who did what.
A cash correction and a store-credit
exchange are decided by the Sales Head.
You see them as "With the Sales Head · you
track".
Money moved after it was taken is checked
one level up.
Sending back always needs a reason. The person who asked has to know what to
fix.
Only the counsellor hard-closes a patient.
You cannot, even on your own desk.
The person who knows the patient best
decides when to stop following up.
Every exit meeting ends with a next step
and a date.
A patient who left without buying is never
forgotten. The follow-up lands in the
counsellor's book.
The day cannot lock while a check is open. No rupee and no visit is left hanging
overnight.
A locked day's money never changes.
Money that comes in after the lock is shown
on its own line.
The locked total is a promise. Nothing is
silently edited.
You lock only your own clinic's day. Each BM answers for their own branch.
Nothing is deleted or overwritten. A wrong
deposit slip is withdrawn with a reason; a
decision stays on the record.
Every change can be traced.
You see your own clinic's money, and only
your own clinic's.
Full sight of your branch, nothing of the
others.
When every BM of a clinic is away, new
approvals go to the Sales Head.
An item never waits for someone who is not
there.

blocks.title: Page 4
blocks.text:
remembers. On a phone, the bottom bar holds Approvals · Sale & revenue · Follow-ups ·
Patients; everything else is under ☰ .
At the top of every page: the search box "Search this page or any patient…", + Add
appointment, and the ? menu with How to use and Report a bug. "Report a bug" does not
send anything yet: it tells you to pass the problem on yourself.
Branch pages, in menu order:
Approvals. The page you open on. Four tabs: Approvals · Exit meetings · Amount
checks · Rejected advances, each with a count. Above them sits the BANK DEPOSIT
strip. On the Approvals tab, Show switches between "Waiting on me", "Decided · last 7
days" and "My own items · with" the Sales Head. A calendar button marks you away for
the day, and a download button exports the list.
Sale & revenue. One page, three views:
Overview has the tiles Total revenue · New · Cross-sell · Products · Tokens · Consult
fees, and the tables New patients, Cross-sell, Re-visits and Products by counsellor.
Click a tile to see its payments.
All payments lists every payment at your clinic.
Reception sale shows discounts over the offer, patients with no counsellor, and
clinic pickups and Rapido orders paid here.
Inventory Tracking. Products sold here in the period, what came back, and the stock
left. The "Mark ordered" button sits on the shortage banner.
Clinic Overview. The clinic floor right now, read only. Three tabs: "Waiting session sign-
off" · "Therapist allocation pending" · "Numbing & treatment". The bell shows "Delay
alarms".
Team today. Mark a counsellor or a receptionist absent for today. Below that is "Team
work · today and right now", one row per counsellor.
Audit results. The auditors' verdicts on your counsellors' consultations. Read only.
Follow-up calls. Two views. Overview shows calls due, on time, late and missed, by
counsellor. No call record lists calls saved as done with no matching call on the clinic
phone, for you to check.
Hand over. Move a leaving counsellor's whole desk to a replacement.
Patient Results. How patients' courses are going, by patient or by doctor. Read only.
Targets. Draft your counsellors' daily, weekly and monthly targets and submit them to
the Sales Head.
Pickups & Rapido. Online orders collected at, or sent from, your clinic. Read only;
reception does the work. These are never your clinic's revenue.
Check-in History. Reception's check-in book, read only, with Export CSV.
End of Day. The day's checks, the cash count, and the lock.

blocks.title: Page 5
blocks.text:
MY COUNSELLOR DESK. These are the counsellor's pages, without Dashboard, Sales,
Close my day, Confirmations, Decided claims and My audit results. Most of them carry a
Viewing bar: pick "All counsellors", "Me" or one counsellor. They open on all counsellors.
How to work them is in the Counsellor guide; this guide does not repeat it. What is
different for you is in the cards "How do I see one counsellor's list?" and "Can I hard-close
a patient?" below.
How do I…? · Approvals
1. How do I approve an item waiting on me?
When you need this: the Approvals tab shows a count, or someone tells you they "sent it
to the BM".
Steps:
1 . Open Approvals. Make sure Show reads "Waiting on me".
2. Read the row: "Waiting on you" (who and what kind), "The change" (the figures), "Their
reason".
3. Press Approve. The dialog reads "Approve · <kind>" and says what approving does
("Once approved: …").
4. Add a Note if you want (it is "optional"), then press Approve ✓.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"This item was already decided — the queue has refreshed." Someone decided it first,
or the facts changed after it was raised (the phone, the package amount, a session
count). Read it again; if it is still wrong, ask the person to raise a fresh one.
"You can't approve your own item — it routes to the Sales Head (no self-approval,
ever)." It is yours; it is not for you to decide.
If Approve is greyed out with "figures missing — Approve is off; send it back to re-
submit", the card has no figures to check. Send it back.
Who to ask: the person who raised it, for missing facts; the Sales Head, if you are unsure.
Search words: approve, approval, manzoori, approve karna, waiting on me, pending,
queue, item, OK karna
Screenshot: [Screenshot to add: Approvals · Waiting on me]
[Screenshot to add: Approvals · the Approve dialog]
2. How do I send an item back?
When you need this: the figures or the reason on a card are wrong or missing.
Steps:
Gleuhr Guide — Branch Manager (draft)

blocks.title: Page 6

1 . On the card, press Send back.
2. Write the Reason ("required"). Placeholder: "What they need to fix before sending it
again".
3. Press Send back.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the button stays off until you write a reason: "Write the
reason — the submitter has to know what to fix." The item returns to the person who
raised it, with your reason.
Who to ask: the person who raised it fixes it and sends it again.
Search words: reject, send back, wapas bhejna, galat hai, wrong amount, return, reason
[Screenshot to add: Approvals → Send back dialog, empty reason]
3. Which kinds of item come to me, and what does approving each one do?
When you need this: a card shows a kind you have not seen before.
Steps: read the kind on the card. What approving does:
Advance verify: verifies an older direct advance. New booking advances are paid by
link and verify themselves; they never come here.
Imported package · mark incorrect: stops chasing an imported package's balance. It
can be undone later.
Phone change: updates the patient's number and logs it.
Treatment correction: records the corrected treatment on the plan. No money moves.
Appointment change required: moves the booking's date, time, type, concerns or
clinic.
Old Gleuhr client — not in the system: the patient counts as Existing instead of New.
Old balance — from before the CRM: puts that amount on the package so it is chased.
Withdraw old-client confirmation: the patient is New again. No money moves.
Pickup store credit — a discount above the offer: gives store credit on a pickup order
sold above the offer.
Session count correction — asked by the doctor: corrects a package's session count.
Cash amendment and Store-credit exchange: NOT yours. They show "With the Sales
Head · you track".
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the dialog always says, in one line, what approving will
do. Read it before you press.
Who to ask: the Sales Head.
Search words: kinds, types, phone change, number change, treatment correction, old
client, purana client, old balance, session count, pickup credit, advance verify

4. Why can't I decide a cash correction or an exchange?
When you need this: a card shows "With the Sales Head · you track" instead of buttons.
Steps: none. You only watch it. When the Sales Head decides, it moves to "Decided · last 7
days".
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the tooltip reads "…approved by the Sales Head. You
can see and track it here."
Who to ask: the Sales Head.
Search words: cash amendment, exchange, store credit, you track, can't approve, sales
head decides
[Screenshot to add: Approvals with a "With the Sales Head · you track" card]
5. How do I see what I raised myself, and where it stands?
When you need this: you raised an item (for example a phone change on your own
patient) and want to know if it is decided.
Steps: Approvals → Show → "My own items · with" the Sales Head. The Status column
reads "waiting on…", "approved by…" or "sent back by…", with the reason.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "Your own items never come to you … You can watch
these, not decide them; they don't hold your day lock."
Who to ask: the Sales Head.
Search words: my items, own item, mera item, raised by me, self approval, status
[Screenshot to add: Approvals → Show: My own items]
6. How do I see what was decided this week?
When you need this: someone asks "did you approve my phone change?".
Steps: Approvals → Show → "Decided · last 7 days". Days are grouped; press Show on a
day to open it. Each line reads "Approved" or "Sent back", and by whom.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "Anything still waiting on you stays under "Waiting on
me", however old it is."
Who to ask: —
Search words: decided, history, record, approved list, kal ka, last week, who approved
[Screenshot to add: Approvals → Show: Decided · last 7 days]

7. How do I mark myself away for the day?
When you need this: you are on leave, or out of the clinic for the day.
Steps:
1 . On Approvals, press the calendar button. Its tooltip reads "Mark me away today".
2. The banner reads "You're away today." Press I'm back to end it.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
While every BM of the clinic is away, new approvals go to the Sales Head, and a consult-
only or product-only close records its exit through the counsellor's form. Items already
routed stay with the Sales Head after you return.
If another BM of your clinic is on the floor, the items stay with that BM.
The away mark lasts the day it was set. The Sales Head can flip it too.
"Couldn't read your staff record, so the away switch is off." Refresh. If it stays, tell the
Sales Head.
Who to ask: the Sales Head.
Search words: away, leave, chutti, absent, not in clinic, cover, coverage, out today
[Screenshot to add: Approvals → "You're away today." banner]
How do I…? · Exit meetings, amount checks and rejected advances
8. How do I run an exit meeting?
When you need this: a new patient finished a consult (or bought only products) and did
not take a treatment. The counsellor answered "Did the BM meet the patient?" when
closing the visit.
Steps:
1 . Approvals → Exit meetings tab. The patient is under "Waiting on you".
2. Meet the patient. Press Log meeting.
3. Pick the Reason not converted: Price / budget · Needs family · Not convinced · Timing ·
Other.
4. Pick What you did: "Tried to rescue — re-pitched" or "Validated the reason — no push".
5. Write the Committed next step (for example: "Will decide after speaking to husband
— call back with the installment option").
6. Pick the Follow-up date: 2 days · 4 days · 1 week. It "Goes into" the counsellor's book.
7. Press Log exit & set follow-up.
Gleuhr Guide — Branch Manager (draft)

9. What if I did not meet the patient?
When you need this: the patient left before you came, or you were with someone else.
Steps:
1 . On the row, press I did not meet (when the counsellor said you met) or Add reason
(when the counsellor said you did not meet).
2. Pick why: "I wasn't in the clinic" · "With another patient" · "The patient left before I
came" · "Other".
3. Write the Note (required).
4. Press Send to the Sales Head or Save reason.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Saying you didn't meet saves both answers for the Sales Head, who takes the final call.
It no longer holds your day lock."
"Add reason": "Saved with the exit. The row clears for End of Day once the reason is in."
Who to ask: the Sales Head decides when you and the counsellor disagree.
Search words: did not meet, nahi mila, missed patient, patient left, not met, disagree, BM
unavailable
[Screenshot to add: Exit meetings → I did not meet dialog]

10. How do I conﬁrm an exit meeting the counsellor logged?
When you need this: an exit sits under "Logged today" waiting for confirmation.
Steps: press Confirm you met ✓ (or Confirm BM met ✓).
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "Couldn't confirm — …" with the server's reason.
Earlier exits still open are listed under "Earlier exits still unreconciled", with the note "the
day can't lock while one is open".
Who to ask: the owning counsellor.
Search words: confirm exit, reconcile, unreconciled, exit pending, confirm met
[Screenshot to add: Exit meetings → Logged today]
11. What about my own patient who did not buy?
When you need this: the patient is your own (the tag reads "Your own patient").
Steps: there is no meeting with yourself. Press Log meeting and fill the same form
directly.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "your own patient: log the meeting" if you try the other
buttons.
Who to ask: —
Search words: own patient, mera patient, self exit, my patient exit
[Screenshot to add: Exit meetings → a row tagged "Your own patient"]
12. How do I read an amount-check ﬂag?
When you need this: the Amount checks tab shows a count.
Steps: Approvals → Amount checks. Each row reads "Patient said ₹ X · CRM shows ₹ Y".
Press Open patient and check the ledger.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "The agent called after the visit and the patient's figure
didn't match. Open the patient to check the ledger." "CRM figure didn't load" has a Retry.
Who to ask: the counsellor and reception, to find where the money went.
Search words: amount check, mismatch, patient said, paid more, kitna diya, figure not
matching, flag
[Screenshot to add: Approvals → Amount checks]
13. What do I do with a rejected advance?
When you need this: the Rejected advances tab shows a count.

How do I…? · Cash and the bank slip
14. How do I upload the bank deposit slip?
When you need this: the BANK DEPOSIT strip says "1 day took cash and has no bank slip
yet: …".
Steps:
1 . Press Upload the slip.
2. Add the Photo of the slip (a photo or the bank's PDF, 10 MB at most).
3. Type the Amount on the slip.
4. Set Deposited at the bank on.
5. Under The cash of, tick each day whose cash this slip carries. One slip may carry
several days (a holiday deposit).
6. Add a Note if needed. Press Save the slip.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the dialog says "Nothing is compared yet": the app
stores the slip and checks nothing. Until everything is filled, it reads "Still needed: …".
When all days are covered: "Every day that took cash has its bank slip."
Who to ask: accounts, if the bank amount is a question.
Search words: bank deposit, deposit slip, slip, bank jama, cash deposit, upload slip, bank
receipt
Screenshot:

15. How do I ﬁx a wrong deposit slip?
When you need this: you saved the wrong photo, amount or day.
Steps:
1 . On the slip's line, press Withdraw….
2. Write Why (required; for example "wrong amount typed"). Press Withdraw slip.
3. Upload the right slip.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "It is kept, marked withdrawn with your reason — never
deleted. Record the right slip after this."
Who to ask: —
Search words: wrong slip, galat slip, withdraw slip, delete slip, change slip
[Screenshot to add: Withdraw this slip dialog]

When you need this: someone has not come in.
Steps:

What you'll see / if it goes wrong: —

2. For each row, check the counsellor's phone record.
3. Press Call record found or Call record not found. Press Undo if you pressed the wrong

What you'll see / if it goes wrong:

How do I…? · Targets and handing over a desk
20. How do I draft and submit my team's targets?
When you need this: a new month, week or day needs targets, or the Sales Head sent the
set back.
Steps:
1 . Open Targets. Pick Daily, Weekly or Monthly.
2. Press the pencil to edit. Each row has Conversions (count), Cross-sell (value) and New
revenue (value).
3. Press Save draft as you go.
4. Press Submit to the Sales Head → when ready.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Your own row routes to" the Sales Head "— no self-set targets."
"These targets are already submitted — recall to draft (or ask the Sales Head to
reopen) before editing."
"Every row needs a counsellor."
The tag reads "Draft", "Submitted to …" or "Locked by …".
Who to ask: the Sales Head locks it or sends it back with an adjusted clinic total.
Search words: targets, target set, monthly target, submit target, conversions, cross-sell
target, new revenue
Screenshot: [Screenshot to add: Targets · Monthly]
21. How do I change targets after submitting them?
When you need this: you spotted a mistake after pressing Submit, or a locked set must
change.
Steps:
Not yet ruled: press Recall to draft. The dialog reads "Recall targets to draft?". Edit and
submit again.
Gleuhr Guide — Branch Manager (draft)
Page 16 of 36

blocks.title: Page 17
blocks.text:
Already locked: press Reopen to draft, write the Reason ("Why the targets need to
change") and confirm. "The Sales Head sees your reason."
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: recall works only before the Sales Head rules. After
that, reopen.
Who to ask: the Sales Head.
Search words: recall, reopen target, change target, target galat, edit target, unlock
[Screenshot to add: Targets → Recall targets to draft? dialog]
22. How do I hand over a leaving counsellor's desk?
When you need this: a counsellor leaves, and a replacement at the same clinic takes their
patients.
Steps:
1 . Open Hand over.
2. Choose Leaving and Replacement (another active counsellor of the same clinic).
3. Read Moves and Stays.
4. Write Why (required). Press Hand over.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: there is no "Are you sure?" step: it runs at once. When
done it reads "<from> → <to>", and "Desk switched off · Login locked". The server may
refuse:
"the replacement must be another active counsellor of the same clinic";
"N live item(s) at another clinic — move it/them from there first";
"N open visit(s) already carry a payment — close it/them first";
"nobody hands over their own desk".
Who to ask: the Sales Head, for a desk at another clinic.
Search words: hand over, handover, counsellor left, resign, chhod diya, transfer patients,
replace counsellor
[Screenshot to add: Hand over → Leaving / Replacement chosen, Moves and Stays]
How do I…? · Sales, stock and the floor
23. How do I see today's sales for my clinic?
When you need this: any time you want the day's money.
Gleuhr Guide — Branch Manager (draft)
Page 17 of 36

blocks.title: Page 18
blocks.text:
Steps: Sale & revenue → Overview. Pick Today, This week, This month or Custom dates.

Both parts must pass, each on its own. A good lesson score does not make up for a
weak task, and the ratings are not averaged. Example: tasks rated 5, 5, 4, 3, 5 is "not
yet"; you repeat the task rated 3.
Every attempt and every rating is kept, with who rated it, the date and the note.
No single mistake fails you on its own. A mistake lowers that task's rating.

your desk shows In training. Nothing is blocked.

visit and call ends with a next step.
4. The patient. Clear and polite, explains what happens next, and hands off to the right
colleague.
5. Pace. Done at a normal desk speed, without holding up the patient or the queue.
Each task's "What a 5 looks like:" line, in their guide, names what to watch for in that task.
Rated 3 or below: write one line saying what went wrong (for example "needed a
prompt to add the UPI reference"). The person practises and repeats only that task.
There is no list of mistakes that fail a task outright. A mistake lowers the rating.
Rating Means

fixed their own small slip

you had to point out

had to fix
